description: Defines the HeadersFooters class managing collections of header and footer objects within a document, including cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: HeadersFooters
classes.description: Represents a collection of header and footer objects in a document, supporting cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern.

classes.name: HeadersFooters.HeadersFootersValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable header/footer properties for HeadersFooters.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the HeadersFooters instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, cloning header/footer objects and setting parent references.

methods.name: IsHeader
methods.description: Checks if this collection is a header within a section.

methods.name: IsFooter
methods.description: Checks if this collection is a footer within a section.

methods.name: HasHeaderFooter
methods.description: Determines if a specific header or footer exists.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the headers and footers into DDL format.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the object and its children.
